human.problem: Five of the six true or false cards are True, and all three in stop 2 are True (cards 6, 12 and 17). Several are close retellings of the verse, like stop 2 card 17, so they read as obviously true and can be answered without reasoning. Stop 2 card 17 also gives Lazarus coming out of the tomb, the passage's climax, only inside a true or false statement.
human.question: Should the docs require a mix of True and False answers across true or false cards? Should they also say that a statement retelling the verse closely enough to be obviously true doesn't meet the informed-guess rule?
